title: Earthquake Simulator Pro (quake_sim)
description:
Web-based research-oriented earthquake and tsunami simulation platform for Japan. v5.8 features: faithful Zhao et al. (2006) GMPE with frozen calibration tables, 1D equivalent-linear site response (Thomson–Haskell + Darendeli curves, SHAKE-91 external benchmark), ensemble uncertainty fields with logic-tree weights, kinematic finite-fault sources (Okada DC3D), recursive multi-level two-way AMR nonlinear shallow-water tsunami solver with optional Peregrine-type Boussinesq dispersion (1960 Chile trans-oceanic validation), hydrodynamic-load hazard metrics, JMA long-period class prediction, EEW detection rehearsal, and a real-time monitoring suite (JMA/Kmoni/EEW/tsunami). All validation results including negative ones are frozen in PHYSICS_BENCHMARKS.md; per-dataset provenance and licences in public/data-catalog.js.

Bundled derived datasets: J-SHIS Vs30 derived grid (J-SHIS terms), JIVSM derived bedrock/column grids (J-SHIS terms), KiK-net surface/borehole derived spectral-ratio statistics (NIED DOI 10.17598/NIED.0004, derived quantities only), GEBCO 2025 resample (doi:10.5285/37c52e96-24ea-67ce-e063-7086abc05f29), JMA observation data (気象庁, government open work).
notes: Source repository: https://github.com/Dongwu259/open_quake_sim (MIT). This record archives the tagged release; the research manifest (public/data-catalog.js) is the authoritative per-dataset provenance record.
